boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research-model family; THOS remains proxy; Freed ID remains synthetic and nonproduction; CBR, legal, cultural, affected-party, and Māori concepts remain under competent and Māori authority. No empirical confirmation, Theory-of-Everything, AGI/ASI, consciousness, personhood, deployment, exhaustive-security, independent-reproduction, or Stage 20 claim is made.

proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic tribunal can reject cache reuse when any declared input, tool version, provenance edge, or negative-result state differs.
proposals.mission_surface: cache key domains, dependency inputs, tool versions, negative caching, eviction, quarantine, and replay witnesses
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier proposals cover manifests, line endings, sparse indexes, and process teardown; none makes cache poisoning and eviction provenance the central falsifier.
proposals.null_or_failure: A stale or foreign cache entry is credited, an undeclared input changes output, eviction erases a failure, or quarantine mutates a sibling lane.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the owner-local cache fixture, retain the mismatch, rebuild from declared inputs, and never touch sibling or host caches.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Every mutation must either change the content key or fail closed; eviction must preserve the retained-negative receipt.
proposals.title: Content-addressed build-cache provenance, poisoning, and eviction tribunal

proposals.hypothesis: A typed symbolic classifier can distinguish declared degeneracy obligations from unsupported claims that an arbitrary GMUT operator avoids an Ostrogradsky mode.
proposals.mission_surface: higher-derivative operator declarations, kinetic Hessian rank, primary and secondary constraint obligations, coupling scope, and mutation rejection
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Prior GMUT tribunals address Bianchi, hyperbolicity, BRST, and radiative obligations; none centers DHOST degeneracy and Ostrogradsky constraint accounting.
proposals.null_or_failure: A label is treated as a proof, rank conditions are omitted, matter couplings are ignored, or symbolic consistency is promoted to physical stability.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reclassify the operator as incomplete, retain the failed vector, and require a model-specific Hamiltonian analysis before any stronger statement.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: The classifier must reject missing Hessian and constraint obligations and must emit no force, likelihood, stability, or empirical claim.
proposals.title: GMUT DHOST degeneracy and Ostrogradsky-obligation classifier

proposals.hypothesis: A fail-closed adapter can document the official DESI DR2 BAO product contract while producing no fit when no data rows or covariance are ingested.
proposals.mission_surface: official product inventory, release status, schema, fiducial assumptions, covariance, blinding, row count, and likelihood refusal
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier adapters address other cosmology and astronomy products; none targets the DESI DR2 BAO compressed-product contract with a mandatory zero-row refusal.
proposals.null_or_failure: Absent rows are imputed, a citation becomes a measurement, covariance is fabricated, or a zero-row run yields a constraint or force claim.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep the mission open, retain the absence, and require an explicitly authorized official data snapshot with verified checksum and schema.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: The receipt must show zero rows, zero likelihood evaluations, zero posterior samples, and zero constraints.
proposals.title: GMUT DESI DR2 BAO compressed-likelihood zero-row adapter

proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic state machine can expose ambiguous readback, stale order identity, skipped hold points, and incomplete restoration handovers.
proposals.mission_surface: three-part communication, order identity, step state, repeat-back, correction, hold point, shift handover, fatigue reservation, and abort semantics
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier THOS studies cover aviation, rail, water, clinical, and other handovers; none models electrical switching-order readback and restoration handover.
proposals.null_or_failure: The proxy is described as operationally effective, real workers or grid assets are implied, an ambiguity passes, or independent review is claimed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw effectiveness language, retain rejected traces, and leave real protocol design to authorized operators and safety authorities.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: All unsafe synthetic traces must be rejected; no real person, station, feeder, order, switching action, or matched-budget arm may appear.
proposals.title: THOS electrical switching-order readback and restoration-handover proxy

proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic vectors can distinguish disclosure validity, holder-binding evidence, and credential-status state transitions without issuing a real credential.
proposals.mission_surface: issuer-holder-verifier roles, selective disclosure, key binding, nonce and audience, status purpose, transition legality, metadata integrity, and privacy
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier Freed ID proposals cover DID, DCQL, Bitstring Status List, and presentation exchange; none combines current SD-JWT VC holder binding with explicit status-transition refusal.
proposals.null_or_failure: Draft requirements are frozen as final, fake keys are called production, status is inferred without a method, or privacy and phone-home risks are omitted.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Downgrade to structural representation, retain each failing vector, and require standards-conformant implementations plus independent privacy and security review.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Vectors must reject nonce, audience, binding, disclosure, metadata, and illegal-status mutations while recording zero real keys or events.
proposals.title: Freed ID SD-JWT VC holder-binding and status-transition profile

proposals.hypothesis: A structural matrix can make missing authority, evidence, confidentiality, and remedy gates visible without deciding a real consumer case.
proposals.mission_surface: medical dependency, hardship support, disconnection safeguards, complaint routes, remedy evidence, consumer privacy, Māori data governance, and authority
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier CBR matrices address other sectors and managed retreat; none centers electricity disconnection, medical dependence, hardship remedy, and confidentiality.
proposals.null_or_failure: The matrix gives legal advice, decides eligibility or remedy, exposes consumer data, asserts cultural legitimacy, or speaks for Māori authorities.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the unresolved case class, remove decision language, and defer to authorized consumer, legal, regulatory, privacy, and Māori processes.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Every real decision path must remain exact-gated to affected people, competent authorities, and Māori authority where applicable.
proposals.title: CBR electricity disconnection hardship, remedy, confidentiality, and Māori-authority matrix

proposals.hypothesis: A no-network disposable fixture can separate expected promisor absence from corruption and prove that offline operations fail closed without canonical mutation.
proposals.mission_surface: filter declarations, promisor provenance, missing-object classification, fetch-if-missing, offline behavior, fsck boundaries, and disposable-fixture cleanup
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Sparse-index work exists, but no prior proposal centers promisor-object classification and offline partial-clone failure semantics.
proposals.null_or_failure: A missing non-promisor object is excused, a network fetch occurs, canonical objects are altered, or disposable evidence is treated as repository assurance.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Delete only the disposable owner-local fixture after retaining its receipt; leave canonical and sibling object stores untouched.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: The fixture must remain isolated, network-disabled, mutation-complete, and incapable of changing canonical or remote state.
proposals.title: Git partial-clone promisor-object offline failure tribunal

proposals.hypothesis: A structural auditor can identify missing or inconsistent table relationships and recommend simpler alternatives without claiming full accessibility.
proposals.mission_surface: caption, summary, th and td roles, scope, id and headers associations, responsive preservation, structural simplicity, and manual reservation
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier accessibility work addresses landmarks, live regions, keyboard paths, and charts; none centers data-table captions, header scope, and complex alternatives.
proposals.null_or_failure: Visual cues are accepted as sufficient, complex headers are guessed, responsive markup loses relationships, or automated checks become conformance claims.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Mark the report structurally incomplete, retain failures, simplify the table, and schedule qualified manual and assistive-technology evaluation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Mutations covering caption, summary, header type, scope, and explicit associations must fail; manual and affected-user evaluation remains reserved.
proposals.title: Accessible data-table caption, header-scope, and complex-alternative audit

proposals.hypothesis: A typed classifier can represent Onsager obligations in physical thermodynamics while refusing conversion into psyche, autonomy, justice, consciousness, or universal law.
proposals.mission_surface: near-equilibrium assumptions, generalized forces and fluxes, parity, microscopic reversibility, positive semidefinite dissipation, reciprocity, and domain labels
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier thermodynamic classifiers cover Clausius, fluctuation relations, exergy, and Gibbs-Duhem; none centers Onsager reciprocity plus an explicit psyche-domain prohibition.
proposals.null_or_failure: Reciprocity is asserted outside assumptions, time-reversal parity is omitted, positivity is ignored, or a metaphor becomes a human or fundamental-law claim.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore physical-domain labels, retain the rejection, and require domain-specific empirical theory before any cross-domain hypothesis.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Every cross-domain or assumption-free mutation must be rejected and no human, psyche, justice, consciousness, or fundamental-law result may be emitted.
proposals.title: Thermo/Psyche Onsager reciprocity typed-domain classifier

proposals.hypothesis: A quarantine ledger can reject repeated-peeking promotion and distinguish fixed-horizon, alpha-spending, and anytime-valid evidence labels.
proposals.mission_surface: analysis peeking, stopping rule, familywise error, alpha budget, e-process labels, preregistration, holdout reuse, and promotion abstention
proposals.novelty_against_390_frozen_proposals: Earlier Stage 20 controls cover leakage, multiplicity, and evidence boards; none makes optional stopping, alpha spending, and anytime-valid label integrity the core tribunal.
proposals.null_or_failure: A fixed-horizon p-value is repeatedly peeked, an e-value label is assumed without construction, holdouts are reused silently, or Stage 20 readiness is inferred.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Withdraw promotion credit, retain the analysis history, allocate a fresh preregistered test only with appropriate evidence, and keep Stage 20 closed.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: All unsafe peeking and label-substitution vectors must fail and the terminal verdict must remain NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.
proposals.title: Stage 20 optional-stopping and alpha-spending quarantine
